subject: Is it possible use Renjin to do Fisher Test

messages.author: 4b0c3dd6f2d83147
messages.subject: Is it possible use Renjin to do Fisher Test
parts:
These two sentences work perfectly fine in R.

engine.eval("m<-matrix(c(31067246,268450,31084245,251451),2,2,byrow=T)");

engine.eval("x <- fisher.test(m)");


When I am using Renjin, the first sentence works fine, for the second one it runs forever.


Is it possible use Renjin to do Fisher Test?


Thank you!

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Is it possible use Renjin to do Fisher Test
parts:
Hi Wang,
Yes indeed this should work - I tested it out and it looks like one of the optimizations we've added recently is choking: there is an expression 
sum(d[d <= d[x - lo + 1] * relErr])
in fisher.test() where d is a deferred execution graph and gets re-evaluated over and over again instead of getting shipped off to the parallel executor. I'll try to have a fix for this today or tomorrow.

Best,
Alex
